summary: Aris Mining Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing an NI 43-101 Technical Report, a Prefeasibility Study for the Toroparu Project in the Cuyuni-Mazaruni Region of Guyana, effective November 12, 2026, prepared by a qualified-person team including Ignacio Velez, Jan Eklund, Dawie le Roux, Kevin Leahy, Chris Fourie and Pamela De Mark. The document covers proposed development, mine and plant design, production schedules, capital and operating cost estimates, and mineral resource and reserve estimates; it makes no mention of any transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic. This is routine technical disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for a future construction decision.
